# Property BasicName

#### BasicName

Gets the name of PDM (i.e. raw name of PDM connection, not localized).

##### Declaration

```
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 18, 400, 60)]
string BasicName { get; }
```

##### Property Value

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  string |   |  

##### Remarks

This property is available since v7.18 SP7.
